'''Artusian crystals''' were a substance found and mined on [[Artus Prime]]. 

==History==
Artusian crystals were considered unstable and/or dangerous, and fell under [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[ordinance 20098-B]], which required regular reports be made regarding their collection and processing to the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|Senate]].<ref name="NRIR">{{LucasArts|url=products/outcast/html/spin.html|text=N.R.I. Reports|int=N.R.I. Reports}}</ref> 

In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the colony administrator on Artus Prime revealed the discovery of a large deposit of such crystals to the Senate; soon after the colony fell to the [[Empire Reborn|Imperial Remnant]], and the administrator's failure to renew his weekly transmission sparked an investigation by [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]].<ref name="NRIR" />

[[File:A-crystal.jpg|thumb|100px|Large Artusian crystal in the [[Kejim Outpost|research facility]] on [[Kejim]]]]
Artusian crystals were the primary component in [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Galak Fyyar]]'s plan to infuse [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|powers]] into [[Human/Legends|Human]] subjects with little [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]]. Initial attempts to do this in [[Kejim Outpost]] were unsuccessful, but the goal was finally achieved after the crystals themselves were infused with the power of the [[Valley of the Jedi]]. A small Artusian crystal was a vital part of the [[Shadowtrooper]] armor.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>

Artusian crystals were described as "very much like [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|those]] found in a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]."<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast" /> This corresponds with the historical use of other [[Force crystal]]s in the construction of lightsabers,<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> although their flexible design allowed for practically any kind of crystal.<ref name="EGttF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

Following the death of [[Desann]], [[Lannik Racto]] possessed at least three of these crystals; they were presumably seized along with the rest of his [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] following [[Second mission to Coruscant (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|his capture]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]]<ref name="TNEC" /> by [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Apprentice]] [[Jaden Korr]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>
